reelection.rule: Rule: next even-year November for this House term. legislators-current.yaml ends the current term on 2027-01-03. The even-year November before that January 3 end is November 2026. The file has no election day, so no day of the month is shown.

vote_frequency.label: In this cached set only (the latest 40 House roll calls, not a lifetime record): 40 of 40. Yea or Aye: 35. Nay or No: 5. Not Voting: 0. donor_industry.caption: From itemized individual contributions over $200 reported to the FEC, grouped by the donor's self-reported employer and occupation. Employer means where the donor works, not that the company gave money; corporations can't give directly to campaigns. Industry groups use simple keyword rules and may misclassify some donors.

stands_for.majority_rule: Party majority = the Yea/Nay side taken by most members of that party who voted Yea or Nay on that roll call, counted from the party code in the roll-call XML (all members, including ones no longer serving). Ties have no majority.

Our veterans have earned the respect and gratitude of a grateful nation, and that appreciation was on display at Bob's Vets' recent Veterans Day celebration.

The event recognized local veterans for their military service and the sacrifices they've made to defend the freedoms we https://t.co/soori1kklg

A very happy 110th birthday to Lake Alfred’s own Lenore “Gundy” Costello! 🎂

We were privileged to help celebrate this remarkable milestone and recognize a life marked by service, community and plenty of adventure.

Happy birthday, Gundy! https://t.co/ABo8APfQdm

We recently joined Citrus Connection to recognize Polk County Commissioner Martha Santiago as she prepares to conclude her term in office.

Thank you, Commissioner Santiago, for your years of service and dedication to the people of Polk County. Wishing you all the best in your next chapter!

Westminster Lakeland recently premiered World War II – From Shore to Shore, a special documentary highlighting the remarkable stories of four World War II veterans.

Their experiences offer a firsthand look at an important chapter in our nation's history and the courage, https://t.co/KbzwJZdXiG

The Greater Bartow Chamber of Commerce recently brought local veterans, businesses and community members together for their Hometown Heroes Veterans Day Luncheon.

Events like this are a great reminder of the strong ties between our veterans and the communities they call home. https://t.co/YEoDzxKaMc

The Avon Park community came together for the Walk for Veterans to honor the men and women who have served our country.

Among those in attendance was Chris Evans, a disabled veteran and cancer survivor known as “Captain America,” who wears his signature costume to share his https://t.co/GSvTBKWZ0b
Taking policing to new heights at @FLPolyU! https://t.co/cTHTF5yrAp

In Haines City, veterans and community members gathered at the Military Court of Honor on Veterans Day to pay tribute to the men and women who have honorably served our nation.

The ceremony featured keynote remarks from retired U.S. Army First Sergeant Darrin M. Adams, while U.S. Marine Corps Sergeant Major Herbert Quiller was presented with a Quilt of Valor in recognition of his military service.

Thank you to all our veterans for their service, sacrifice and unwavering commitment to our country.

Calling all middle and high schoolers interested in West Point!

Meet West Point cadets at the Lakeland Main Public Library on Nov. 24 from 4–6 PM. Students in grades 7–11 and parents can learn about cadet life, military training and the admissions and nomination processes. https://t.co/b7LL0WRFDy

Today, I joined @SpeakerJohnson and a bipartisan group of House colleagues on the Capitol steps to recognize our nation’s veterans.

During my 26 years in the Navy, I had the privilege of serving alongside some of the finest Americans I’ve ever known. Veterans Day is an https://t.co/8oxYmfvFPc

Our annual Vet Fest is coming up on November 21!

From 9 AM to noon at Publix Field at Joker Marchant Stadium in Lakeland, attendees can connect with organizations offering assistance with VA benefits, health care, mental health services and other valuable resources.

Admission https://t.co/MhDBgJBgF9

Our annual Vet Fest is coming up on November 21!

From 9 AM to noon at Publix Field at Joker Marchant Stadium in Lakeland, attendees can connect with organizations offering assistance with VA benefits, health care, mental health services and other valuable resources.

Admission and parking are free. We hope to see you there!

On Veterans Day, we honor the men and women who answered the call to serve and the sacrifices they made in defense of our nation.

To every veteran across FL-18 and throughout America: thank you for your service, your courage and your commitment to our country. 🇺🇸 https://t.co/5cQEOqqWiI

Congratulations to @Jim_Jordan on his election as House Minority Leader! There’s important work ahead to rein in federal spending, strengthen our national security and advance policies that grow our economy and support American families. I look forward to working together to get the job done. 🇺🇸

Congratulations to Trinity Christian Academy of Lakeland on its grand opening. Access to reliable childcare is important for working parents, and this new addition will help meet that need while creating local jobs and providing more options for families in FL-18. https://t.co/XkpWtlo5I2

For 251 years, the U.S. Marine Corps has stood ready to defend our nation wherever duty calls.

Today we honor the generations of Marines whose courage, discipline and service have built the Corps’ proud legacy. Happy Birthday to the United States Marine Corps. Semper Fi! https://t.co/6brLtL156m

November is Native American Heritage Month, a time to recognize the history, culture and contributions of Native American communities across our country.

For generations, Native Americans have helped shape the American story through military service, agriculture, business, https://t.co/j7rOCsQQ79

From the classroom to the lab, STEM skills are opening doors to new careers and helping America stay at the forefront of innovation.

On #STEMDay, we celebrate the students and educators turning curiosity into discovery and preparing to tackle the challenges ahead. https://t.co/1Cs7Cehae3

Thank you to LTC Mark Milia, USA (Ret.) for his years of dedicated service on our Service Academy nomination board. The nomination process carries an important responsibility, and I appreciate the time, experience and judgment he's contributed to helping evaluate students seeking to serve our country.

Board Chairman Col. Gary Clark, USAF (Ret.) presented him with a letter of appreciation recognizing his contributions to the board and commitment to the next generation of military leaders.

Congratulations to the students from across FL-18 who completed their Service Academy nomination interviews as part of the selection process.

Over 40 years ago, I received a congressional nomination to the U.S. Naval Academy from then-Congressman Andy Ireland. I know firsthand https://t.co/Z8dD3ZV1lA

Following my request to expand Florida's flooding state of emergency, @GovRonDeSantis has added several counties to the existing declaration, including Okeechobee, Glades and Hendry. I appreciate the Governor's action to ensure more communities impacted by flooding have access to the resources and assistance they need to recover.

If you live in one of FL-18's six affected counties—DeSoto, Glades, Hardee, Hendry, Highlands or Okeechobee—you can find local emergency management information and available resources at https://t.co/pIzTq96TLX

Great to be back at SunTrax in Auburndale to see the progress being made in advanced air mobility.

Polk County has an important role to play in the future of aviation, with opportunities to attract new investment and create high-paying jobs. As Co-Chair of the Congressional https://t.co/gPsyH9MvR2

FL-18 is quickly becoming a hub for the next generation of aviation.

I joined the Lakeland Economic Development Council for a panel on advanced air mobility, SunTrax and the work underway to safely integrate these new technologies into our national airspace. As Co-Chair of the https://t.co/xjOnKeETWT
Wishing everyone across FL-18 a safe and happy Halloween! https://t.co/1FH51mmRqG

For Americans living with kidney disease, reliable access to dialysis treatment is essential.

I met with DaVita Kidney Care to discuss challenges facing dialysis patients, federal policies affecting coverage and the importance of maintaining treatment options for patients across FL-18.

Having been a Rotarian for 25 years, I've always appreciated Rotary's commitment to service and strengthening our communities.

It was good to join the Rotary Club of Auburndale to provide an update on our work in Congress and the issues impacting Florida families and businesses. Organizations like Rotary play an important role in bringing people together, supporting local needs and keeping our communities strong.

When emergencies happen, our first responders are the ones running toward the danger.

On National First Responders Day, we thank the police officers, firefighters, EMTs and other emergency personnel who put service before self to keep our communities safe! https://t.co/v1KYFwPfDS

If there’s one fictional account that captures the essence of Florida’s roots better than any other, it would undoubtedly (IMHO) be “A Land Remembered,” by Patrick D. Smith.

I met with Tampa native Todd Wiseman Jr., who is bringing Smith’s classic novel to the screen.  We https://t.co/h4MJLvbfVr

Agriculture is a major part of Florida's economy, and FL-18 plays an important role in feeding families across our state and nation.

Our team joined the Highlands County Farm Bureau's annual meeting to connect with local producers and discuss our continued work to support Florida ag. I appreciate their recognition of our office's efforts on behalf of the industry and the communities that depend on it.

The Medal of Honor represents the highest standard of courage, sacrifice and service to our nation.

The Second Annual Florida Medal of Honor Memorial Gala brought together military leaders, veterans and supporters, including retired U.S. Army Colonel Mike Borders and Brigadier https://t.co/AjTGPC6YiH

Lakeland continues to grow, and managing that growth responsibly while providing needed services to our existing residents in a fiscally responsible manner is no easy feat!

Our team had a great meeting with Mayor Sara Roberts McCarley to discuss what’s ahead for @lakelandgov and how we can continue working together to support local businesses, strengthen infrastructure and plan for the future.

Strong partnerships between local and federal leaders help us better serve residents and ensure FL-18 remains a great place to live, work and do business!

Florida Poly continues to put Central Florida at the forefront of emerging technology.

I met with @FLPolyU President Dr. Devin Stephenson and Vice President of Information Technology & CIO Cole Allen to discuss the university’s future and its growing work in artificial https://t.co/4fqHj4KCmw

Polk County is growing quickly, and making sure families can still afford to put down roots is an important part of that growth.

I appreciated the opportunity to speak with the Lakeland Association of Realtors about housing affordability, private property rights, infrastructure and the challenges facing homebuyers across our community. Realtors see these issues firsthand, and their perspective is valuable as we work to expand opportunity and keep FL-18 a great place to live, work and raise a family.

Today on National Day of the Deployed, we recognize the service members carrying out our nation’s mission around the world and the families who support them from home.

We’re grateful for their sacrifice, courage and commitment to keeping America safe. https://t.co/pp4AHeFBqw

BIG news for Polk County and American ag!
 
The Trump Administration has selected a Bartow fertilizer project for nearly $20 million to expand American-made fertilizer production.
 
I've long fought to strengthen domestic fertilizer production, most recently calling on @USDA and https://t.co/5Gf4bUL8HE

It’s always a pleasure catching up with State Senator Colleen Burton to talk about what's happening across Polk County.

From infrastructure and water resources to housing and economic development, decisions made at the local, state and federal levels all play a role in how our https://t.co/ymGPxZNPDE

Lakeland Linder International Airport continues to be a hub for aviation, innovation and education in Central Florida.

I toured the Aerospace Center for Excellence to hear about preparations for SUN ’n FUN 2027, ongoing airport projects and efforts to introduce more students to https://t.co/ZlNJyGIcgS

For students interested in aviation and aerospace, the Central Florida Aerospace Academy in Lakeland offers opportunities that go well beyond the traditional classroom.

I toured CFAA to learn how students are gaining hands-on experience in flight training, aircraft maintenance, https://t.co/6HKFCOg0fN

From autonomous vehicles to advanced air mobility, SunTrax is helping test the next generation of transportation technology.

I enjoyed catching up with the @MyFDOT team to hear about the latest developments at the facility and how its testing capabilities are helping companies https://t.co/3vPdef1gQU

Ever wonder how your favorite @Publix ice cream gets made?

We toured the Publix dairy plant in Lakeland, where milk, tea, ice cream and other products are prepared for stores across the Southeast. Since opening in 1980, the facility has been a longstanding part of Polk County’s https://t.co/WcNhBwQpol

Bok Tower Gardens has been a Lake Wales landmark for nearly a century, welcoming visitors from around the world and playing an important role in our local tourism economy.

I enjoyed spending time at @boktower with President and CEO Miles Arnott, as well as carillonneur Geert https://t.co/B7FzaKiKCP

Some of the world’s most important weather missions launch from right here in Lakeland.

The @NOAA_HurrHunter Aircraft Operations Center at Lakeland Linder International Airport is home base for @NOAA’s specialized aircraft fleet. From flying into hurricanes to conducting https://t.co/vjWJqLbg63

Innovation is happening right here in Lakeland.

I had the chance to visit Catapult and see how local entrepreneurs are turning ideas into growing businesses. From its workspace and commercial kitchen to its makerspace for manufacturing and engineering, Catapult gives founders https://t.co/01XHjcXDi8

Hardworking Americans shouldn't be footing the bill for fraudsters exploiting taxpayer-funded programs. Every dollar lost to fraud hurts taxpayers and those who genuinely need assistance.

I'm joining @VP in his pledge to stop fraudulent payments, strengthen oversight and hold https://t.co/Oey286Xy4u

Congratulations to Dr. Alice Beth Barfield on representing Glades County at the National Association of School Superintendents’ celebration of education leaders from across the country.

Being named a finalist for the 2026 NASS Superintendent of the Year is a well-deserved recognition of her commitment to improving student achievement, expanding educational opportunities and serving the students and families of Glades County.

Florida’s National Guard answers the call at home and abroad, from hurricane response to overseas deployments, but its force structure has not kept pace with our state’s rapid growth or increasing mission demands.

I joined @SenAshleyMoody and members of Florida’s congressional delegation in calling for an increase in the Guard’s authorized force structure. Florida’s soldiers and airmen continue to deliver when our state and nation need them, and they deserve the personnel and resources necessary to carry out the mission and meet Florida’s growing needs. Read the letter here 👇
https://t.co/ARLV0kgtop

October is Breast Cancer Awareness Month. This month, we recognize those battling breast cancer, honor the survivors and remember the lives lost to this terrible disease.

Early detection saves lives. I encourage women across FL-18 to stay informed, schedule regular screenings and take charge of their health.

It was great to spend time with the @FLSouthern Moccasin Battalion and talk with the next generation of Army leaders as they prepare to commission next spring.

For 75 years, Florida Southern’s ROTC program has trained officers for the Army, Army National Guard and Army Reserve. As a retired Naval Aviator, I always appreciate the opportunity to hear from young men and women who have chosen a path of service to our country.

Polk State College plays an important role in preparing students for careers and meeting the workforce needs of our growing region.

I met with President Stassi Kamoutsas to hear about his first 90 days leading the college and his vision for what comes next. We discussed workforce training, expanding educational opportunities and how @PolkState can continue building strong pathways from the classroom to good-paying careers across FL-18 and beyond.

For 251 years, the U.S. Navy has stood watch around the world, defending our nation and protecting freedom at sea.

As a retired Naval Aviator who served 26 years, I’m grateful for the generations of Sailors who answered the call and those who continue to serve today. Happy Birthday to the United States Navy!

America’s farmers put in the work every day to keep food on our tables and communities across the country moving.

On National Farmers Day, we recognize the men and women whose long hours, resilience and dedication sustain our nation. Thank you to the farmers across Florida’s Heartland and beyond who keep America growing.
Today we recognize Columbus Day and the enduring spirit of exploration that has shaped our nation for generations. https://t.co/1bFSvNjVQs

The new Lakeland Senior Hub is bringing resources, wellness and community together under one roof for seniors across Polk County.

The 44,000-square-foot facility has already engaged 74 businesses and nonprofits to help connect folks with services, education, physical activity and one another. It’s great to see another resource in FL-18 focused on helping seniors stay active, informed and connected.

🚨 I just sent a letter to @USDA and @CommerceGov demanding immediate action as sulfur shortages and rising costs force American fertilizer plants to cut production.

Last month, I led Florida's congressional delegation in raising the alarm. Now, jobs, local businesses and farmers are paying the price.

The Administration must move beyond reviewing this crisis and deliver a coordinated plan to secure sulfur supplies, remove costly barriers and get production back on track.

The Annual Okeechobee Farm Bureau meeting was a good opportunity to hear directly from local farmers and recognize the work they do to keep agriculture strong in our community. I appreciate the recognition from @FlaFarmBureau as a supporter of Florida agriculture and will keep working to stand with the farmers and ranchers who help feed our state and nation.

Florida Poly is leading the way in preparing students for high-demand careers and building the workforce of tomorrow.

It was great to showcase the incredible work happening at @FLPolyU to @Sonderling47 during a roundtable focused on connecting education with the evolving needs of employers. His visit also marked the first time Florida Poly hosted a sitting U.S. Secretary of Labor.

Florida’s citrus growers are continuing the fight against citrus greening, and that work takes everyone.

Our team joined growers and industry leaders from across FL-18, including longtime citrus policy leader Rick Dantzler, fourth-generation grower Jim Snively, Frostproof nursery owner Phillip Rucks, @Sen_Albritton, @FLCitrusMutual and the Citrus Research and Field Trial Foundation team. By sharing research, resources and firsthand experience from the grove, we can keep working toward a stronger future for Florida citrus.

A reliable water supply is critical to FL-18’s continued growth. At the Polk Regional Water Cooperative’s Southeast Wellfield Project, @GarneyConstruct is helping build the infrastructure needed to deliver millions of gallons of clean drinking water each day to communities across the county.

We had a good discussion about Garney’s employee-ownership model and the opportunities it creates for workers. Giving employees a stake in the company they help build rewards hard work and allows them to share in its long-term success.

Three years ago today, Hamas carried out the deadliest terrorist attack in Israel’s history, murdering nearly 1,200 people and taking more than 250 hostage.

Today, we remember the innocent lives taken on October 7th and the families forever changed by that horrific day. We stand with the people of Israel and remain committed to confronting terrorism and antisemitism wherever they appear.

(1/2) Americans should be able to trust that science informing federal policy is based on sound research, not politics or predetermined outcomes.

Today, I introduced the Establishing Gold Standard Science Act to codify key provisions of President Trump’s Gold Standard Science agenda and strengthen transparency, accountability and scientific integrity at EPA. ⬇️

Enjoyed attending the Lakeland Economic Development Council’s monthly meeting and hearing from recent Graduate Medical Education (GME) graduates. This community effort helps attract, train, and retain doctors to address our primary care shortage. We’re grateful these new physicians have chosen to call Lakeland home and care for our community.

Please join me in praying for everyone affected by this morning’s crash involving a Polk County school bus in Winter Haven.

Thank you to the first responders on the scene. Please avoid the area as we await more information. https://t.co/JeuO1ZIUag

A pretty stark reminder of what’s at stake. America was built on individual liberty, free enterprise and limited government. We should be strengthening the principles that made America exceptional, not tearing them down. https://t.co/rXxoL20qJB

Every child deserves a chance at life. I’ve consistently fought to protect the unborn and oppose taxpayer funding for abortion. I also reintroduced the Prohibiting Abortion Industry’s Lucrative Loopholes Act to close loopholes allowing abortion providers to profit from fetal tissue.

I’m proud to maintain an A+ rating with @sbaprolife and will continue fighting to defend life.

Options for Women PHC is doing important work to support mothers, strengthen families and protect unborn children across our community.

Their Vision for Life luncheon was a chance to recognize that work and the lives they’re helping change. Over the past year alone, they report helping save more than 596 children’s lives. Thank you to everyone at Options for Women PHC for all you do!

We recently joined Highlands County Sheriff Paul Blackman, Major Darin Hood, State Rep. Kaylee Tuck and Sen. Erin Grall for a tour of the Sheriff’s Office’s new facility.

It was a good opportunity to see the new space firsthand and hear more about the department’s work and priorities. Thank you to Sheriff Blackman and his team at @HighCoSheriff for all they do to keep Highlands County safe.

The Annual Region VI SWAT Team Challenge brought together over a dozen law enforcement agencies, including departments from Highlands, DeSoto and Collier Counties.

Congratulations to the Highlands County Sheriff’s Office on taking the overall win! The competition was a strong display of the training, teamwork and professionalism these men and women bring to serving their communities every day.

The Hardee County Chamber of Commerce’s monthly meeting highlighted the work local organizations are doing to support businesses and strengthen the community.

It was a great opportunity to recognize the men and women helping employers grow, connect with resources and create new opportunities for families across the county. Thank you for the work you do to keep Hardee moving forward!

financial_disclosures.caption: Official House financial disclosure filings from the Clerk of the House. A filing lists assets, income, liabilities, and trades the member reported; it is not proof of a conflict or of wrongdoing. Dollar ranges and asset names are in the PDF. This page links to the Clerk's copies and does not score anyone.

funding.heading: Disclosed campaign receipts
funding.detail: Federal cards show the principal campaign committee and OpenFEC totals for one two-year cycle, plus itemized Schedule A contributors. House uses 2026. Senate uses the cycle of the next election (2026, 2028, or 2030). This is not career fundraising and does not include Schedule E outside spending. Governors do not get a federal contribution list.

town_halls.note: There is no national town-hall dataset. Dates are not estimated.

disclosure_note: Disclosed contributions only; donors behind groups that do not report their own donors are not in this feed.
vote_scope: This is not a full career record. The cache is the latest 40 House rolls (2026, rolls 275-314) and 40 Senate votes (119th Congress, session 2, votes 217-256).
